map.CAPE对流有效位能计算: CAPE Convective Available Potential Energy Calculation

map.对流有效位能 CAPE = g × (ΔT / Te) × Δz，其中 ΔT =: Convective available potential energy CAPE = g × (ΔT / Te) × Δz, where ΔT = parcel temperature − environmental temperature (K), Te is the environmental temperature (K), and Δz is the buoyancy layer thickness from LFC to EL (m, estimated by the hypsometric equation Δz = R_d·Tm/g·ln(p_LFC/p_EL), with Tm the mean parcel/environment temperature), g = 9.80665 m/s² and R_d = 287.04 J/(kg·K); CAPE>0 indicates available convective potential energy, and the larger it is the easier it is for severe convection to develop, often paired with CIN (convective inhibition) to judge whether strong lift is needed to trigger it. Common thresholds: 0-1000 J/kg weak (isolated thunderstorm), 1000-2500 J/kg moderate (thunderstorm likely), 2500-4000 J/kg strong (severe thunderstorm/hail), ≥4000 J/kg extreme (explosive convection).
map.💡 公式：CAPE = g × (Tp − Te) / Te × Δz，其中 Δ: 💡 Formula: CAPE = g × (Tp − Te) / Te × Δz, where Δz = R_d·Tm/g·ln(p_LFC/p_EL) is the buoyancy layer thickness (m), Tm is the mean parcel/environment temperature, R_d = 287.04 J/(kg·K), g = 9.80665 m/s², and temperatures are in kelvin; maximum updraft speed w_max = √(2×CAPE).
map.本工具采用简化常数浮力法估算 CAPE，假设气块与环境温差在整个 LFC-EL: This tool uses a simplified constant-buoyancy method to estimate CAPE, assuming the parcel-environment temperature difference is constant across the whole LFC-EL layer
map.实际 CAPE 需完整探空资料逐层积分计算，本结果为近似估计: Actual CAPE requires full sounding data with layer-by-layer integration; this result is an approximation
map.浮力层厚度 Δz 按压高公式以气块/环境平均温度估算，高温层结下比实际层厚偏大，: The buoyancy layer thickness Δz is estimated by the hypsometric equation using the mean parcel/environment temperature; under warm stratification it is larger than the actual layer thickness, so the result is conservative (on the high side)
map.CAPE > 0 表示条件性不稳定，数值越大对流潜势越强: CAPE > 0 indicates conditional instability, and the larger the value the stronger the convective potential
map.气块温度须高于环境温度（Tp > Te）且 LFC 气压大于 EL 气压才有正: Positive CAPE requires the parcel temperature to be higher than the environment (Tp > Te) and the LFC pressure to be greater than the EL pressure

map.上升气流强度：w_max = √(2×CAPE)，估算理论最大上升速度。: Updraft strength: w_max = √(2×CAPE), estimating the theoretical maximum updraft speed.
map.潜势分级：按 0–1000 弱、1000–2500 中等、2500–4000 强: Potential grading: 0-1000 weak, 1000-2500 moderate, 2500-4000 strong, ≥4000 J/kg extreme, against convective strength.
map.算法：CAPE = g×(ΔT/Te)×Δz（J/kg，g=9.80665 m/: Algorithm: CAPE = g×(ΔT/Te)×Δz (J/kg, g=9.80665 m/s², temperatures in kelvin), Δz is the buoyancy layer thickness from LFC→EL, estimated by the hypsometric equation Δz = R_d·Tm/g·ln(p_LFC/p_EL) (R_d=287.04 J/(kg·K), Tm the mean parcel/environment temperature); theoretical maximum updraft speed w_max = √(2×CAPE). Grading: ≤0 stable, 0-1000 weakly unstable (isolated thunderstorm), 1000-2500 moderate (thunderstorm likely), 2500-4000 strong (severe thunderstorm/hail), ≥4000 extreme (explosive convection). Note that the layer thickness uses the geometric thickness corresponding to the pressure difference, not the pressure difference itself.
map.例：气块 25℃、环境 20℃、LFC 700hPa、EL 300hPa → Δ: Example: parcel 25°C, environment 20°C, LFC 700 hPa, EL 300 hPa → ΔT=5 K, Δz≈7.3 km, CAPE = 9.80665×(5/293.15)×7330 ≈ 1226 J/kg (moderately unstable), w_max ≈ 49.5 m/s (theoretical upper limit; in practice reduced by about 30%-50% due to entrainment and precipitation drag).
map.CAPE 大就一定会有冰雹吗？: Does high CAPE mean hail is certain?
map.不一定。CAPE 只代表浮力潜势，还需触发条件（低层辐合、锋面或热力抬升）、合适: Not necessarily. CAPE represents only buoyancy potential; triggering conditions (low-level convergence, frontal or thermal lift), suitable 0°C/−20°C level heights and 0-6 km wind shear are also needed; with very high CAPE but large CIN or no trigger, convection often fails to develop all day.
map.为什么理论最大上升速度偏高？: Why is the theoretical maximum updraft speed on the high side?
map.w_max = √(2×CAPE) 假设浮力全部转为垂直动能、且无夹卷与降水拖曳: w_max = √(2×CAPE) assumes all buoyancy converts to vertical kinetic energy and ignores entrainment and precipitation drag, so it is an ideal upper limit; measured updraft speeds are typically 50%-70% of this value.
map.关于「CAPE对流有效位能」: About the "CAPE Convective Available Potential Energy"
map.对流有效位能（CAPE，Convective Available Potenti: Convective available potential energy (CAPE) is an important thermodynamic parameter for measuring the atmospheric convective potential. This tool takes the parcel temperature, environmental temperature and the pressures of the level of free convection (LFC) and equilibrium level (EL), and uses a simplified constant-buoyancy method to estimate the CAPE value and the theoretical maximum updraft speed, assisting severe convection weather forecasting.
